themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Articles focusing on AI agents designed to perform research tasks, automate workflows, or act as autonomous researchers.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Content related to AI tools that help developers write, debug, or refactor code, including discussions on their security implications.

themes.name: AI research platforms
themes.description: Tools and platforms designed to facilitate AI-driven research across various domains, from scientific discovery to data analysis.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Articles discussing AI's ability to condense large amounts of text, such as transcripts, reports, or earnings calls, into concise summaries.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Discussions around the creation and use of AI-generated personas or data to simulate user behavior for testing or analysis.

themes.name: AI-powered data analysis
themes.description: Content covering the application of AI techniques to analyze datasets, extract insights, and identify patterns.

themes.name: AI tool evaluation
themes.description: Articles that compare, benchmark, or review different AI tools and platforms for specific use cases or industries.

themes.name: AI for design & research
themes.description: Focuses on AI's role in augmenting or transforming the design and user research processes, including prototyping and system design.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Research and discussion on the capabilities, limitations, and impact of AI chatbots, particularly in information retrieval and advice-giving.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Articles examining how AI is affecting jobs, creating new roles, and reshaping the professional landscape.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
